description: Exploit, a time-neutral booster that targets the end-point, where averaging forms (E005 showed the late phase is worth about 1 pp). On the E027 tip, keep label smoothing at 0.3 for the first 85% of steps and set it to 0 for the final 15%, which lies entirely inside the 32 px phase. Pass LS as a GPU scalar into the compiled loss, or capture a second 32 px step variant in build, with error_on_recompile on. Nothing else changes. Judge on held-out seeds 3–12 as well as seeds 0–2.
